finish.title: Finish picking
finish.subtitle: {{orderNo}} · {{store}}
finish.variancesHint: Tap a line to go back
finish.note: Submitting saves each line's picked total as the order's ship qty. Short lines are submitted as picked.
finish.confirmBody: Still picking: {{names}}. They can't make changes once you submit. Submit anyway?
finish.blockHint: An item counts as done once it's picked or marked out of stock. If a segment truly can't be finished, ask a manager to clear or reassign it on the order page.

stockout.title: Location out of stock
stockout.reasonNotFound: Can't find it in the warehouse
stockout.hint: If you find it later, scan it to count and the mark clears automatically.

route.title: Pick route
route.subtitle: Sets the order of Up next and All lines · this device only
route.mDesc: Enter every row from the aisle end, go to the farthest pick, then come back. Bays always low to high.
route.sDesc: Snake through the rows: odd rows bays low to high, even rows high to low, exit at the far end.
route.note: Location codes read as zone-row-bay-level, e.g. A-03-12-02 = zone A, row 03, bay 12, level 2. Irregular codes come after, lines without a location always last.

packLater.inCartonHint: Qty of this product in the current carton. Tap the number to type it.
packLater.editHint: Total of this product in the current carton. 0 takes it out.
